prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person wearing a black long-sleeve crop top and light blue flared jeans"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06"].

message.content: {"matches":["P05"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"P05 is wearing a black long-sleeve crop top and light blue flared jeans, matching the description exactly. All other individuals either wear different tops (e.g., white, black with white stripes, or sleeveless) or different pants (e.g., black joggers, black pants with side stripes). No other person visibly satisfies the full description."}

parsed.reason: P05 is wearing a black long-sleeve crop top and light blue flared jeans, matching the description exactly. All other individuals either wear different tops (e.g., white, black with white stripes, or sleeveless) or different pants (e.g., black joggers, black pants with side stripes). No other person visibly satisfies the full description.
